mapper.select: SELECT oi.food_id as food_id, oi.food_name as food_name, o.store_id as store_id, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as total_sales FROM order_detail oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status like 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY oi.food_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT oi.food_id as food_id, oi.food_name as food_name, oi.food_image as food_image, SUM(oi.quantity) as sale_count, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as sale_amount FROM order_detail oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY oi.food_id, oi.food_name, oi.food_image ORDER BY sale_count DESC
